faq.heading: Answers before you choose a plan
faq.q1: Where is my data stored and who can access it?
faq.a1: Documents and extracted data are stored in Supabase (PostgreSQL + Storage). Row Level Security means every user sees only their own documents — no one else, not even on the same plan.
faq.a2: Solo covers Slovak, Czech, and English. Fleet adds German and French. Pro supports every current language, including early access to new ones.
faq.q3: What accuracy can I expect from day one?
faq.a3: Extraction runs on Claude with high accuracy on legible scans and photos. Uncertain or illegible fields are flagged and left for you to fill in on the editable form before saving.
faq.q4: What support comes with each plan?
faq.a4: Solo gets best-effort email support. Fleet guarantees a reply within 24 hours. Pro gets a dedicated contact and assisted onboarding.
